title: Deformation parameter and quantum gauge group
html: The substrate parameter q \in \mathrm{End}(\mathbf{1}) characterizes the \mathbb{G}_m-family of interpolations between the full differential d and the vertical projection \pi_V \circ d. Fixing q deforms the categorical dimension of the fundamental object from 2 to [2]_q = q + q^{-1}, and the gauge group from \mathrm{SU}(2) to \mathrm{SU}_q(2). Every subsequent physical feature—commutators, Reeb derivations, and action traces—is governed strictly by this single categorical parameter.
